Lua 5.4 — gameplay scripting VM.
Upstream: https://www.lua.org (MIT, see lua/src/COPYRIGHT in the release tarball;
license header is also present atop each source file).

Files vendored: lua/src/*.c + *.h EXCEPT the standalone tools
(lua.c interpreter/repl, luac.c compiler) which the engine does not ship.

NOVAForge usage: NFScripting links this static library and exposes a small
`nf.*` API (logging, math, entity transform access) to game scripts.

To refresh: download a newer lua-5.4.x.tar.gz, replace lua/src (again
dropping lua.c/luac.c), update this file, rebuild lua + NFScripting.
Pinned: lua-5.4.8 (2026-09-16).
